reading.zh: 一次调用的路径：命令行入口解析出目标与动作 → 脚本引擎（可选的批量编排）→ 窗口识别与闸门 → 感知出口（读屏幕，只报告；也可以先让人用鼠标框一块）→ 输入注入 → 原生互操作。下方三组是工程支撑。
reading.en: One invocation flows left to right: the CLI resolves target and action, the script runner batches them, the window layer verifies the target, perception reads the screen and only reports (or lets a human draw the region), input injects, native does the syscalls. The lower group is engineering support.

title.zh: 运行时（一条命令的一次执行）
